changes: Treat horizontal structural ceilings and flat roofs from procedural multi-storey wall arrays as usable furniture-placement floors at their actual elevation.
Use the top mesh triangles to preserve irregular structural outlines and lift/skylight holes; do not support furniture spanning missing floor areas.
Ignore only the supporting slab collider, not the remaining walls in its procedural room group; retain object visibility, clearance and ownership rules.
Do not fall back to ground-level placement when an elevated supporting floor exists under the camera but has no clear spot; keep scene and object ID persistence unchanged.
Preserve all prior robot autonomy, city teamwork, multiplayer, metadata, GLBs, media and persistent room contents; no schema migration.

Expose per-account Meta retry, maximum backoff, and planning cooldown settings with server persistence and a credential-source diagnostic; clear stale missing-key timers when credentials become available.

Convert explicitly addressed can-clearing requests into saved executable orders: identify home and table cans, hold and drink, create a procedural bin, store verified empty cans as persistent container inventory and repeat.
Increase in-world comic bubble capacity and readability; show real speaker activity on controlled robot portraits using a subtle border-only animation and microphone overlay.

Make minimap translucent, draw world-object footprints and flash a grounded object marker when a robot mentions that named scene object; encourage landmark-based spatial language rather than raw coordinates.
Maintain owner permissions, scene object IDs, existing Meta usage caps, physics, and prior navigation/multiplayer changes. No live deployment claimed.
Allow an explicit human @all instruction to start up to three owner-authorized persistent local construction work orders; broad aspirational chat is not an authorization.
Use verified deterministic build-house and park/picnic furniture tool sequences even when Meta inference has no configured key, with saved stable object IDs and no uncontrolled scene edits.
Interpret requested plural homes as two bounded furnished house projects per assigned robot; never overwrite active robot work orders or invent playground equipment.
Parse one-hour wandering as a timed multi-leg patrol, and a 15m retreat with random turn as separate collision-checked motion stages; permit safe bounded fallbacks, no teleports.
Retain every prior 0.2.211 smooth multiplayer robot motion, fence navigation, object ownership, scene persistence, GLB assets, and no database schema migration.
Stream actual autonomous navigation positions, heading and gait state at roughly 9Hz to other signed-in clients; render between snapshots instead of jumping between infrequent scene saves.
Keep the original collision-aware path and fence checkpoint pauses on the owner client while remote avatars smoothly follow that same route and use walking/run/idle animations.
Preserve the manual keyboard-prediction network path, lift transport, room permissions and persistent scene objects; avoid stale checkpoint rewinds while a live motion stream is active.
Bound and authorise robot-motion WebSocket relay and sequence numbers; continue saving final positions and five-second recovery checkpoints without writing every animation frame.

Navigate around long picket fences, hedges and path walls with adaptive, bounded 8-connected A* search instead of repeatedly plotting a failed straight crossing; validated 120–320m barrier detours and angled physical footprints.

At significant barrier-route bends, briefly stop to capture real 3-direction head-camera JPEGs, keep the same mission/destination, and replan if live scene geometry changes. Existing 120-second Meta perception reservations may additionally interpret the forward view, with the same quotas and spending guards.

Correct robot route debug: a blocked goal now shows its red destination ring and obstacles, not a red straight line pretending to be a usable route. Measured movement trail remains cyan and planned safe path green.

Renew authenticated one-time robot-life leases during long journeys, preventing another tab from taking control while the same robot navigates; terminate safely on lost renewal. Keep casual social visits local and avoid repetitive recently visited targets.
Improve robot conversation grounding in recent client-reported exploration; distinguish actual saved work orders and completed world edits from enthusiastic but non-executable group discussion.

Separate opt-in Autonomous roaming & peer visits in Brains: visible signed-in browser explores using collision-checked A* paths (typically 11–19m) and visits new scene points instead of repeated 2–3m walks.

Every 6 seconds the local robot life loop considers new activity without billing Meta. The server grants a 22-second ownership lease, defers to explicit human tasks and saved work orders, and rejects unauthorized or replayed movement receipts.

Arrival or collision outcomes, including measured actual displacement, are traced and consolidated as explicitly client-reported experience in existing robot memory; real camera frames can be captured after exploration and existing Meta visual analysis remains separate.

Upon an actual arrival beside another robot, optionally ask a bounded evidence-based question using the existing authorised robot-to-robot communication route, subject to cooldowns; no uncontrolled world edits or object mutations.

Make I a true pickup/drop toggle for held equipment: pressing I while holding a shovel releases it to the shared world, without requiring a backpack or opening Inventory. Existing transient-carry drop stays intact; Shift+I remains backpack handling.
Make B toggle inventory visibility, label I/U/B directly in Held controls and shortcut help, remove duplicate Drop from tool cards and keep Inventory open during grip editing and aimed digging.

Match the Transform inspector format: single-line Attach (hand, bone, Follow), Angle X/Y/Z and reset, Action clip; Advanced contains hand offset/contact axes only, initially collapsed. Remove repetitive instructions and unify label font size.

Suppress incorrect missing-physics-body warning for currently equipped items (their physics bodies are deliberately removed while held). Preserve object IDs, per-hand grips, saved scenes, avatars and backend schema without migration.
Add always-visible Drop Shovel (right) / Drop Saw (left) controls in the Held inventory toolbar above the scrolling item list, wired to persistent equipment release with edit permission checks.
Fix giant inventory tool cards and hidden action buttons by using compact content-sized rows and constrained preview thumbnails.
Replace long Tool Grip panel with compact hand, rig-bone, angle and action-clip selectors; collapse hand/handle offsets in optional Advanced calibration details.
Retain all v0.2.205 shovel tool use, animation features, avatar models, stored equipment data and multiplayer protocols; no migration.
Shovel Use now performs digging at open ground directly ahead or at a clicked target within reach, creating a persistent excavation footprint with owner and room revision.
An authored Digging clip is selected when the avatar GLB provides one; the bundled avatar has no Digging clip, so a lightweight procedural arm-and-spine motion is used by default.
Add configurable per-tool action clip choices, an authenticated WebSocket pose relay, and strict shared realm validation for excavation and held-tool animation events.

Retain B → Held → Drop, Store, Switch hand, Grip, all previous changes and original media assets. Excavation is a visual ground marker, not physical ground cutting; other tool actions are optional animation only.
Provide per-tool, per-hand adjustable skinned-bone grip profiles: exact rig bone or hand aliases, follow-rotation, local hand offsets, tool rotation offsets and handle contact point.
Default to the actual avatar hand bone instead of finger joints; use tool-specific handle grips for shovel, axe, rake, broom, mop, stick and saw.
Expose Inventory → Held → Switch hand / Grip and Selected Tool → Tool grip settings, with live preview, reset and persistent multiplayer profiles.
Validate and persist grip profiles in scene objects, object presets, realm exports and imports; retain all v0.2.203 authorization and prior improvements. No DB migration or tool-action claim.
Fix captioned and untagged robot vocatives in explicit command parsing so CC: Jessica, stop is correctly interpreted as a stop command rather than chat.
Restore 403 owner-only room-policy enforcement for CC/untagged STOP, including when Meta is unavailable.
Clear rejected reaction reservations so failed authorization never consumes the message for later permitted execution.
Retain all v0.2.202 conversation-continuity enhancements, persistence, original GLB assets and watcher packaging.
Fix multi-tab profile takeover: a stale tab never evicts a freshly authenticated tab or deletes its browser token, even when both tabs share the same valid token.
Make public site login backend-first with a retryable health check and explicit offline error rather than silent local-demo sign-in.
Make room/AI setup failures nonfatal for an authenticated session: scene load always starts when the active token remains valid.
Prevent duplicate sign-in submissions, show clear recovery-key errors, retain user recovery material, and preserve all scene/GLB data.
Allow profile recovery-key export while signed out, and prevent accidental logout of an already-invalid session.
Persistent held-item state for right and left avatar hands, with hand-bone/fallback animation tracking and no physics collision while held.
Held tab, Hold nearby, Hold, Store, Drop controls; bag/pocket size restrictions and backpack availability enforced.
Server-side atomic hand occupancy and avatar authorization checks, safe avatar-deletion release of held/pocket/worn equipment, and import/export holder ID remapping.
Preserve previous furniture persistence, indoor placement, road drawing, room snapshots, user README, and original GLB model assets.
Restore Draw road and motorway in outdoor open terrain without the furniture-placement collision/camera distance gate rejecting an unsaved infrastructure draft.

Explicitly positioned, non-persistent infrastructure paths, fences, hedges, vegetation/ground plots, freehand 3D curves and portal pairs bypass the smart furniture planner until their drawing tools position completed objects.
Normal furniture, tools, primitive objects and presets retain safe camera-aware collision-checked placement and existing multiplayer per-object saves.
Preserve all previous indoor tabletop placement, scene backups, database recovery protections, Meta AI workflows and original 3D avatar/model binaries.
Correct indoor placement regression: small props now prefer visible non-overlapping table, stool and cabinet tops rather than being rejected as overlapping the supporting furniture.
Support low broad cube floors and horizontal plane platforms as actual walkable surfaces, so existing indoor floors do not block placement of other furniture.
Use full world-space footprint containment, vertical support height, per-support collider exclusion, occlusion checks, recent-item proximity, and a safe ground fallback.
Preserve existing per-object authoritative multiplayer scene saves, scene-recovery protections, previous releases and original model binaries.
Smart viewport-aware initial placement for manually added primitives, furniture, procedural tools, equipment, and saved presets: keep near recently added object and camera where possible.
Collision and occlusion checks consider real transformed mesh bounds, individual wall surfaces, open doorways, long fence segments, floor elevations and camera frustum.
Reject unsafe/no-view candidates before publishing; clean up rejected preset objects and rigid bodies without persisting deletions.
Maintain existing v0.2.196 scene persistence, backups, multiplayer event validation, all previous features and original 3D assets.

Fix rejected procedural furniture/tool/device scene saves and presets: full client 129-field configurations pass strict 200-field server compatibility limits, with type/range/allowlist/media validation intact.

Reject malformed or unexpectedly empty same-room loads without clearing locally rendered objects; retain a bounded read-only browser scene copy.

Fix procedural cube-preset openings validation and strict furniture/stair/wall preset shape handling.
Persist single-line stair colour/texture through canonical parametric state and cross-client reloads.

Show scene object save success/failure, revision gaps and reconciliation in Live diagnostics, beyond presence messages.
Use atomic full-scene writes and raise scene capacity to 512 consistently across scene updates, clone and archive operations.
Preserve all v0.2.193 tools, equipment, laptop/fridge states, original GLBs and prior app features.

Add keyboard, trackpad/mouse/stylus device modes, mouse, decorative printer, foldable laptop and hollow fridge to Equipment.
Add persistent open/closed object state, click/tap interactions, ownership/undo support, and TV/monitor-compatible laptop media channels.

Retain non-blocking Umami tracker, rainbow wordmark, fence-aware navigation and unchanged 3D model GLBs; include full implementation spec and regression tests.

Use CSS-only overlay animation with the original neutral .help text always present underneath, no JavaScript, no network dependencies, and no layout changes.
Respect reduced-motion preferences by leaving the original static logo intact; preserve existing analytics, navigation, robots, and watcher release contract.
Add opt-in-free Umami website analytics via the supplied analytics.mielniczuk.com endpoint and website ID, without modifying the Meta/robot application module graph.
Load the tracker only after page load and idle scheduling, with an independent async script so analytics latency cannot delay 3D startup, DOM readiness or normal user interaction.
Ignore blocked or failed analytics requests, remove a hanging tracker after 8 seconds and never retry in a loop; test load/error/timeout/startup isolation.

A verified chat movement to a colleague can relay the requested next step after arrival; that message does not bypass the colleague’s autonomous work-order permissions or claim to execute construction.

Harden Meta Responses extraction and schema validation against malformed model output, including null content and non-string action, roof and furniture fields; rejected payloads cannot throw TypeError in parse-decision.

Prioritise named collaboration before hospital construction in recurring autonomous work orders; persist verified contact IDs and report missing colleague contacts separately from hospital/furnishing objectives.

Continue inspecting and furnishing an existing compatible robot-built house within the same autonomy cycle instead of always returning a partial result; avoid reusing an old small house as a larger hospital.

Add targeted regression tests for chat operator roles, destination targeting, malformed Meta output, hospital task ordering and persistent contacts; preserve existing avatar, ownership, navigation and watcher contracts.

Deployment correction: multi-handle conversation messages (for example @Jessica talk to @Elox) no longer invoke implicit camera capture when the secondary handle is a conversation target. Explicit visual questions and ordinary one-to-one spontaneous camera refresh remain available.

Flask integration regression for two-hop robot dialogue now verifies single addressed recipient and excludes false needs_vision routing; package replaces the original v0.2.189 release rejected before GitHub/Ubuntu publication.
Robot encounters are now wall-aware: candidate meeting points must have an unobstructed physical line to the other avatar, preventing apparent arrivals through a window or solid wall.

When a robot is inside an Office Wall house, the navigator searches viable paths through actual doorway gaps; sealed rooms remain inaccessible. Near-wall starts can safely move away without clipping masonry.
Robot avatars no longer act as fixed global navigation obstacles. Runtime collision checks yield temporarily and attempt a bounded detour around moving neighbours without pushing them.
Active routes recheck real scene geometry for moved furniture or changed doors and retarget moving robots without teleports or false completion.

Character dialogue is shorter and more conversational, with at most one optional grounded aside; it now receives saved work orders and recent client-reported work results rather than only generic camera summaries.
New route/door/scene-change regression tests and fully versioned browser import map; existing GitHub/Ubuntu watcher and original avatar binaries unchanged.

Repair robot routes across houses: replace unsafe straight-line 18 m midpoint chunking with route planning through free staging points, so robots can walk around a building to another robot without requiring the straight line to be clear.

Improve robot follow/retarget behaviour: use collision-checked approaches on several sides of the target robot with stable feet-centred capsule bounds rather than an animated model bounding box or a single target-side offset.
Exclude out-of-height office wall sections, roof accessories and elevated stair treads from ground-level navigation obstacles, without removing actual wall collisions at the robot height.

Add geometry-level regression tests for 5×4 m house detours, long/diagonal routes, robot stand-off approach, and impossible barrier rejection; preserve route debug, real walking and strict arrival proof.
No changes to deployment watcher, server persistence or original model assets; unchanged authenticated mission and scene permissions.

Simplify autonomous Work orders to context-sensitive settings: hide unrelated object, destination, preset, variant, goal, cadence and vision inputs by selected work mode; direct building is one-shot and does not repeat spawning furniture in loops.

Give robots a geometry-based reachable worksite discovery planner that scans several nearby candidate spaces, checks complete object/room footprints against current scene obstacles, and validates A* routes to an exterior staging point without asking the human to relocate the robot.

Before any direct furniture or house creation, animate the robot walking to its reserved staging point via the existing route controller and verify its actual client position and arrived event; show a brief construction gesture before authorizing scene Add, never teleport geometry to the actor.

Recheck the selected building footprint at commit time; reject occupied sites rather than placing through another object; retain normal ownership, physics colliders, Undo and persistence. No automatic destruction or edits to original avatar files.

Add unit and integration-source tests for workspace search, entire rectangular clearance, unreachable site, contextual work modes, and move-before-build sequencing; preserve existing watcher packaging and version metadata.

Add deterministic recovery planning to agent loops with bounded retries, Meta exponential backoff, resume of unfinished house furnishing, one site recheck, relevant public research, colleague assistance and rest before reporting a blocked state.

Avoid duplicate house shells when re-running robot agent work orders. Build a larger, multi-bed bounded structure for hospital goals while explicitly retaining lack of medicine and patient-care tools as incomplete work.
Persist authenticated, bounded client-reported robot work receipts in SQLite to ground later discussions in actual work steps, failures and remaining tasks.

Route project status/recent-achievements discussions to a concise two-robot colleague exchange rather than a formal debate with irrelevant [S1] citations; preserve the sourced research debate for genuine evidence questions.
Allow topic-scoped, rate-limited optional public encyclopedia reading for construction/navigation goals from fixed HTTPS endpoints; do not treat summaries as building standards or code execution.

Attempt an explicit text-only Meta fallback on six-image TypeError, and continue with permitted scene tools if Meta remains unavailable. Do not imply provider outage is repaired without live verification.
Add regression tests, preserve deployment watcher, avatar binaries and current scene persistence; live browser, Meta, WebXR and actual scene placements remain to verify.

Redesign Routines with Schedules/Work orders/Runtime log tabs, adjustable window dimensions and expanded 1,800-character goal input; improve failure visibility, recovery suggestions, copyable per-tab routine traces and tool documentation.
Replace Brains scroll-and-fold interaction with Vision, Identity, Learning, Decision log and Memory tabs; provide one-click Copy log in the top bar alongside existing JSON export.
Expose a safe, versioned Robot Tool API for bounded house blueprints, account-owned saved Architecture/Furniture presets, existing navigation/carry/seat routines and scene mutation controls.

Construct real procedural room walls with door, windows and roof, a separately persisted floor, and bed/table/chair where collision-free. Keep operation results explicit and partial on blocked construction.

Improve Meta autonomy planning validation, provider error diagnostics, 360-degree image request fallback only for incompatible HTTP 400/413, and deterministic construction recovery for explicitly authorized house goals; preserve three-minute cooldown and daily budget.
Add regression checks, uphold GitHub watcher packaging and avatar GLB preservation; real-browser/Meta/WebXR verification remains required.
Add opt-in autonomous robot work orders with multi-step delivery, furniture construction, colleague assistance, resting, and model-directed decision loops.
Reuse existing robot A* routing, physical pickup/drop, authored/procedural seating, editable scene creation/removal and owner permissions; report only verified action outcomes.
Capture six real 60° robot-eye JPEG views for optional Meta Muse Spark 1.3 decision proposals, with existing SAM 3.1 visual search for object detection.
Restrict AI decisions to a validated action vocabulary and real scene identifiers; bound decisions to three-minute robot cooldowns and daily account quotas; never let models call arbitrary tools.
Preserve prior multiplayer, GitHub HTTPS watcher, original avatar GLBs, and existing manually configured routines; autonomous loops stop with the tab, room or session.
Fix Brave/Safari inconsistent room counts by resolving the signed-in profile’s saved realm before starting its authenticated WebSocket connection.
Treat the server room snapshot as join confirmation, refresh authoritative presence every 15 seconds, and reconcile late movement packets when a presence notification was missed.
Reconnect sockets with bounded backoff rather than permanently stopping after two failures; replace lingering same-user WebSocket sessions safely without removing the active replacement.

Make per-browser room and application debugging visible to regular users in the existing Dev log via a Live diagnostics tab, including room, participant count, socket/JS errors and robot event summaries, with Copy/Clear and credential filtering.
Add multi-client and disconnect regression tests and preserve all existing browser/scene, avatar, GitHub HTTPS and watcher deployment contracts.
